Check out the song "Ghoda" a wicked track with unusual satirical lyrics by Daler Mehndi.
"Ghoda" authored and composed by Daler Mehndi is a groovy number with unusual satirical lyrics. Music and the words create an artistic contrast that is the appeal of the song.
It is a satirical song and actually shows a different outlook on life, quite the reverse of the popular style. The singer would rather pursue his traditional lifestyle, and not go in for the luxuries that the modern lifestyle has to offer. He is quite content with his life, and is not enamored or tempted by the new trends in life.
